## DELETE `/api/instances/hostInitiatorPath/{id}`

**Tier:** T3  

Delete a host initiator path. This interface works for stale initiator path only. Normally, a host initiator path will disappear automatically if it is logged out from the host or cable disconnected. But in some cases such as an FC host which is auto created, the initiator path may stay in logged out state when cable disconnected.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Unique identifier of the hostInitiatorPath instance. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Responses:** `204` No Content
